tasks.short: Investigate hazardous conditions and collect samples

steps.what: Investigate hazardous conditions, spills or reported outbreaks and select sampling locations
Collect samples for analysis and preserve their identity and custody

tasks.design: Retain investigation and physical sample collection with qualified people. Instructions in {DOCS} support execution; no separate clerical tracking share is established here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The condition must be assessed at the site and samples collected correctly.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability removes these physical and contextual actions.
tasks.still_hard: Changing hazards can make the original sampling approach unsuitable.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize unsafe or unrepresentative sampling conditions and seek specialist direction.
tasks.altitude: Field responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Select follow-up evidence for an incident investigation
reach.learn: How field conditions affect sample representativeness

evidence.claim: SampleManager LIMS tracks sample identities and tests; this capability does not remove physical investigation or collection time.

assumptions: Boundary includes investigation and sample collection, excluding laboratory analysis and later report preparation. No separate tracking baseline is invented.

The supervising scientist supplies investigation and sampling instructions before s1. The technician produces locations and observations during s1, then sample IDs, collection times, containers and custody details during s2. Capture remains in the retained time; no structured safe-site or representative-sample flag is assumed.
Native tracking configuration would precede code if an administrative burden is established. No new service is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Field authority, hazard controls and current sample tracking
research_questions: Is there a distinct repeated tracking action outside necessary field observation and custody capture?

incremental.description: No new service or work transfer

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and net=0 with zero upkeep. Investigation, collection and custody work retain their shares.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record test results and prepare reports

steps.what: Record test data and verify the report input and interpretation brief
Prepare result tables and charts from the verified test data
Prepare narrative summaries that interpret the test results

loop.input: Verified findings, qualifications, tables and charts
loop.check: Technician checks conclusions, uncertainty, units and whether comparisons actually support the wording
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual completion for unsupported or ambiguous statements
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative qualifications vary; fixed templates handle only headings and numeric tables

steps.what: Check and accept the report for supervisory review

tasks.design: Generate tables and charts from verified inputs in {SPREADSHEET}, testing equivalent native reporting in {OTHER}, the laboratory records system, first. A bounded narrative draft in {DOCS} follows the technician's findings; scientific release stays with the existing supervisor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated chart formatting and narrative wording followed source verification.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed table templates and a source-bounded draft can reuse verified results.
tasks.still_hard: Qualified results and detection limits must not become unsupported compliance conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the tests establish and which comparisons are scientifically valid.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly; interpretation and supervisory release rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review the defensibility of a test report
reach.learn: How sampling and method limitations constrain conclusions

evidence.claim: LabWare LIMS generates certificates of analysis with signatures and audit trails; this supports report assembly capability rather than automated environmental interpretation.
The bounded narrative and local time savings are an unmeasured design scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is recording completed test data and report preparation, excluding field work, original analysis and final supervisory release. Existing supervisor review stays unchanged outside this denominator.

Test operators produce result records before s1. The technician captures sample ID, date, method, value, unit, detection limit, qualifier, source version, comparison scope and intended findings in s1; all verification and manual transcription sit in its 35 hours. Missing metadata requires manual reporting. No free compliant or valid-result flag is assumed.
Test native laboratory report configuration before custom tables or model assistance. Existing automatically generated charts earn no additional saving.
unknowns: Current reporting automation and narrative share
research_questions: Can the workflow reproduce a report containing censored results without changing their meaning?

incremental.description: Report mapping and draft exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact source versions, result tables, charts, narrative and qualifications handed to the supervisor; any change voids acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=35+14+20=69, gross=31, upkeep=7, net=24. Range 0-10 allows existing table automation, short reports and extensive qualification checks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Discuss test results and analyses with customers and clarify their questions

tasks.design: Keep result explanation and customer questions with the technician. The accepted report in {DOCS} supports discussion; report production is counted separately rather than saved twice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Customers need contextual explanation and may ask questions outside the original report.
tasks.enabler_now: No separate administrative preparation baseline is established in this task.
tasks.still_hard: A technically correct result may not answer the customer's practical question.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty and limits without presenting an unsupported assurance.
tasks.altitude: Customer contact and technical scope remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the limits of an environmental assessment
reach.learn: When a customer's question requires additional investigation

evidence.claim: Interactive explanation of test meaning remains human work; report-generation capability does not establish a reduction in the discussion itself.

assumptions: Boundary is the discussion, excluding report creation in 1549 and new tests. Customer participation and scientific escalation remain unchanged outside focal time.

The responsible report author and reviewer produce an accepted report before discussion. Customers produce questions during s1 before the technician clarifies or refers them; understanding is checked within its full time, without a free understood-results flag.
Native access to accepted reports precedes code. No new service or upkeep is proposed, so incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Frequency of questions requiring scientific escalation
research_questions: Which report qualifications do customers commonly misinterpret during discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Report assembly savings belong to 1549; the conversation retains time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Weigh, analyze or measure collected sample particles using laboratory instruments
Calculate pollutant concentration from the verified measurements and method formula
Assess measurement quality and accept the pollutant concentration result

tasks.design: Keep sample handling and instrument work in {OTHER}, the laboratory measurement system. Configure the prescribed arithmetic in {SPREADSHEET} only where it is currently manual; the technician retains quality assessment and result acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: A verified set of measurements still needed repeated formula application.
tasks.enabler_now: Locked method-specific formulas can calculate concentrations from explicit inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Contamination, calibration issues and unsuitable samples cannot be resolved by arithmetic.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the measurement supports a defensible concentration result.
tasks.altitude: Potentially less repeated calculation; physical analysis and quality decisions remain intact.

reach.learn: How blanks, recovery and uncertainty qualify a concentration

evidence.claim: Fixed method formulas can calculate concentrations from verified measurements; no new physical analysis saving or measured local benefit is established.

assumptions: Boundary is analysis of collected particles, excluding sample collection and reporting in 1549. This scenario applies only to manual repeated arithmetic not already performed by instruments.

The supervising scientist supplies the method and formula before s1. During s1 the technician captures sample ID, method version, measured mass or response, blank, dilution factor, sample volume or mass, units and quality-control observations and verifies them; all capture stays within 70 hours. Missing or incompatible values stop the formula and require manual method review. No free acceptable-quality flag is assumed.
OTHER means laboratory measurement system. Test native instrument or laboratory calculation configuration before a workbook or code; existing runtime earns no labour savings.
unknowns: Whether concentration is already calculated automatically
Method-specific quality controls and authority to accept results
research_questions: Does any repeated concentration calculation remain manual after instrument outputs are considered?

already_counted.description: Physical analysis, measurement and input capture

incremental.description: Formula validation and failed calculation upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact sample, method version, source measurements, formula, units, calculated concentration and qualifications accepted; changes require renewed acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=85, gross=15, upkeep=5, net=10. Range 0-3 allows instrument-calculated concentrations or minimal arithmetic relative to physical analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Field work and customer explanations remain human; report assembly and any residual manual arithmetic may shrink.
reach: Learn assessment limits with an environmental scientist
Learn analytical quality controls with a chemical technician
role.ambitious_version: A technician who can reproduce a result and its report while preserving scientific review and field judgement.

job.title: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health
